g.text: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.desc: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.text: PARTIAL: logical connector and TCA9539 0x74 status I/O. No new MCU. Source-policy integration OPEN.

g.desc: PARTIAL: logical connector and TCA9539 0x74 status I/O. No new MCU. Source-policy integration OPEN.

g.text: A1=A0=0:0x74. At POR all ports input. CHG_REQUEST external pulldown and R407 DNP prevent unintended charge.

g.desc: A1=A0=0:0x74. At POR all ports input. CHG_REQUEST external pulldown and R407 DNP prevent unintended charge.

g.text: P00/P01=rail PG;P02=gauge;P03..P05=charger status;P06=charge request;P07=MUX ST. P10..P17 have100k pulldowns.

g.desc: P00/P01=rail PG;P02=gauge;P03..P05=charger status;P06=charge request;P07=MUX ST. P10..P17 have100k pulldowns.

g.text: PWR_INT is expander interrupt only; gauge wake needs P02 drive-low then input release, NEVER drive-high.

g.desc: PWR_INT is expander interrupt only; gauge wake needs P02 drive-low then input release, NEVER drive-high.

g.text: Connector/pullups/off-state behavior and source-policy I/O remain OPEN. No GPIO4 allocation; Core uses SDA47/SCL21.

g.desc: Connector/pullups/off-state behavior and source-policy I/O remain OPEN. No GPIO4 allocation; Core uses SDA47/SCL21.
